questions.solution_html:
Number between 2000 and 5000 is a 4 digits number.
For the multiples of 3 , the sum of digit must be divisible by 3 .
There are only 2 ways of selecting the digits so that 4 digit number with the given digits can be formed, i.e. 0,1,2,3 and 0,2,3,4.
The number of ways of forming number with digit 0,1,2,3 is 2×3 ! ‌‌[∵0 and 1 cannot be place on thousand place]
The number of ways of forming number with the digit 0,2,3,4 is 3×3!‌‌[∵0 cannot be place on thousand digit]
Hence, the required number of ways
‌=2×3!+3×3!
‌=3!(2+3)=6×5=30

questions.question_html: Which of the following compound has reducing character?
questions.option_a: SO2
questions.option_b: TeO2
questions.option_c: SO3
questions.option_d: TeO3
questions.solution_html:
SO2 shows reducing character because +6 oxidation state of S is more stable than its +4 oxidation state.
TeO2 shows oxidising character because its +4 oxidation state is more stable due to inert pair effect.
SO3 and TeO3 do not shows reducing character because S and Te are in +6 oxidation state, which is their highest oxidation state.

questions.question_html:
Assertion (A): All noble gases are monatomic.
Reason (R): All noble gases have very low melting and boiling points.
questions.option_a: Both (A) and (R) are correct and <fmath alttext="(R)" class="fm-inline"><mrow><mo class="fm-mo-Luc">(</mo><mi class="fm-mi-length-1" mathvariant="italic">R</mi><mo class="fm-mo-Luc">)</mo></mrow></fmath> is the correct explanation of (A)

questions.solution_html: All noble gases have completely filled valence shell. So, they do not form bonds with any other atom and hence they are always monoatomic. Since, the noble gases have weak interatomic force, they have very low melting and boiling points. Hence, Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
